description:
Make the `scripts/generate-shipped-policy-regions-selftest.sh` self-test pass as the registered gate `shipped-policy-regions-selftest` over the script it tests.

## Background

`scripts/generate-shipped-policy-regions-selftest.sh` is a re-runnable self-test of `scripts/generate-shipped-policy-regions.sh`: idempotence on a current tree, restoration of a corrupted region with every byte outside its markers kept, and failure on malformed markers. It exits 2 when `git` or `jit` is missing. Until planning, no gate ran it. The gate `shipped-policy-regions-selftest` was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning, so this task and the container can require it; this task makes it pass and keeps its inputs complete.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `shipped-policy-regions-selftest` runs `scripts/generate-shipped-policy-regions-selftest.sh`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `shipped-policy-regions-selftest` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
title: Shipped-policy region generator self-test runs as a declared gate
